stories.title: United States Grand Prix: Formula One qualifying – live
summary: As our Giles Richards wrote:In first practice at the Circuit of the Americas, Ferrari’s Charles Leclerc topped the timesheets from Verstappen, with Lando Norris third for McLaren and Russell and Antonelli in fourth and fifth.

Ferrari had brought their final swathe of upgrades to the race and on the early showing they had found some extra pace.In the afternoon running Leclerc was once more on top, four hundredths clear of Antonelli in second.
Verstappen was in third, from Hamilton in fourth.Many thought Russell [would be winning a maiden title] when the season started in Australia.
